kind: Actual measured computation under assigned cooperative resource-acceptance quotas

config.status: local exploratory specification before calibration and validation; no external preregistration
config.memory_resource: Total fresh-child process peak resident memory in bytes, including import and warm-up
config.cpu_resource: Child user plus system CPU seconds for input construction, computation, and verification, excluding import and warm-up
config.observation_policy: Run every declared size in randomized order using fresh children; retain all outcomes; largest completed size is zero if none and upper-censored if the grid maximum completes
config.primary_endpoint: Largest-completed-size survival profile on the fixed size grid, by assigned budget condition
config.main_forecast: Replay whole paired calibration cost profiles under frozen budget pairs
config.decision_rule: Freeze calibration-based nominal predictive error tolerances before validation; report every full-profile error and comparator difference, without inferring universal law or calibrated population-level coverage
config.interpretation: Actual measured computation under experimentally assigned cooperative acceptance quotas; evaluates prospective cost-model transfer and observation machinery, not spontaneous neutral allocation

design.method: Draw whole measured calibration cost profiles; balanced budget strata; conditional on this calibration sample
design.tolerance_rule: Quantile of max absolute survival error; allow one observation quantum 1/n to avoid a zero tolerance
design.limitation: Conditional design calculation without a guaranteed false-positive rate; does not propagate unknown hardware drift

uncertainty_method: Whole calibration blocks and paired validation blocks; validation resampled within frozen budget strata. Nominal bootstrap intervals remain conditional and exploratory; serial drift is not identified.

summary.scope: Prospective transfer of independently measured workload costs; assigned quotas and acceptance rule do not establish autonomous allocation or a natural law.
